axis.def: One of the two number lines of a graph: the horizontal axis runs across the bottom and the vertical axis runs up the side. Each is labeled with the variable it measures.

coordinate.def: A point on a graph written as an ordered pair (horizontal value, vertical value), such as (300, 10).

direct-relationship.def: A direct (positive) relationship: two variables rise or fall together. In an inverse (negative) relationship, one rises as the other falls.
